name: Caesar Salad
description: A classic Caesar salad recipe with romaine lettuce, crumbled bacon, croutons, and a homemade dressing.

recipeInstructions.text: Rub salad bowl with garlic.
Wash and tear lettuce. Dry in a tea towel.
Place lettuce in bowl with bacon and croutons.
Blend dressing ingredients together.
Pour dressing over salad and toss until leaves are coated.
Serve with freshly grated Parmesan.

keywords: Caesar salad, bacon, croutons, homemade dressing

_similar.name: Romaine Salad with Orange
_similar.description: A refreshing salad featuring romaine lettuce, oranges, and red onion with a light vinaigrette dressing.
recipeIngredient: ¼ cup red wine vinegar or cider vinegar

recipeInstructions.text: In a large bowl, combine the torn romaine lettuce, drained mandarin oranges, and thinly sliced red onion.
In a separate bowl, combine the red wine vinegar, oil, minced parsley, garlic, salt, and pepper to make the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad and toss to coat.
Serve immediately.

_similar.keywords: romaine salad, orange salad, vinaigrette dressing

_similar.name: Bacon Broccoli Salad
_similar.description: A hearty broccoli salad with crispy bacon, red onion, and a tangy dressing featuring low-fat yogurt and feta cheese.

recipeInstructions.text: Combine the broccoli, red onion, sunflower seeds, raisins, and crumbled bacon in a large salad bowl.
In a separate bowl, mix together the yogurt, mayonnaise, sugar, and lemon juice to make the dressing.
Pour the dressing over the salad ingredients and toss to coat.
Refrigerate for 2 hours to allow the flavors to meld.

_similar.keywords: broccoli salad, bacon salad, yogurt dressing

_similar.name: Greek Salad
_similar.description: A refreshing Greek salad with marinated tomatoes, mixed greens, feta cheese, and a homemade dressing.

recipeInstructions.text: To Marinate Tomatoes: Cut tomatoes in halves or quarters. Squeeze out seeds and juice and cut into bite-size pieces. Whisk marinade together, stir in tomatoes, and let stand for at least 1 hour.

To Make Dressing: Place garlic, vinegar, and seasonings in a blender and whirl to blend. While still whirling, gradually drizzle in the oil. Add anchovies. Can be used immediately or covered and refrigerated.
To Complete Salad: Mix greens, onions, olives, pepper, and cheese. Add marinated tomatoes. Toss and drizzle dressing over salad. Add croutons if desired.

_similar.keywords: Greek salad, marinated tomatoes, feta cheese, homemade dressing

_similar.name: Tomato Chickpea Salad
_similar.description: A refreshing salad featuring chickpeas, diced tomatoes, cucumber, and feta cheese, dressed with a tangy vinaigrette.
recipeIngredient: 1 (28 oz) can chickpeas, rinsed and drained

recipeInstructions.text: In a large bowl, combine chickpeas, diced tomatoes, cucumber, green onions, and feta cheese.
In a small bowl, whisk together olive oil, vinegar, garlic, tarragon, parsley, mustard, pepper, and cayenne pepper.
Toss the dressing with the salad ingredients until well coated.
Cover and refrigerate for several hours before serving.

_similar.keywords: chickpea salad, tomato salad, Mediterranean salad, vinaigrette dressing

_similar.name: Broccoli Supreme
_similar.description: A chilled broccoli salad with raisins, bacon, and a creamy cheese dressing.
recipeIngredient: 6 or 8 slices bacon, cooled and crumbled

recipeInstructions.text: Beat dressing ingredients until smooth.
Add dressing to broccoli, raisins, and onion. Cover and chill at least 3 hours.
Sprinkle with bacon and serve.
